scope: Reporting interpretation and artifact availability only; no execution, hidden-gold access, or rescoring.
provenance: Recorded aggregate plus researcher handoff identifying two answerable no-citation responses; read-only ledger check confirms 798 citation-bearing responses and valid hashes for all 1000 payloads. No gold was opened to reclassify cases.

artifact_availability.factual: Five local response databases present; selected-arm payload hashes verified. Aggregate result remains the committed record.
artifact_availability.visual: Local result and response database match the existing committed hashes.
artifact_availability.confirmation_024: Raw generated artifacts not found locally; committed aggregates and artifact hashes remain.
artifact_availability.qualification_010: Raw generated artifacts not found locally; committed aggregates and artifact hashes remain.

limitations: Sensitivity arithmetic is not a replacement evaluation or newly measured quality result.
Missing raw artifacts limit independent per-case verification; hashes alone cannot reconstruct evidence.
The frozen scorer is preserved; future instruments must distinguish citation presence from validity.
severe_release_definition: Answer released when expected action is not answer; not a count of all unsupported claims on answerable cases.
